# Anders Neumann

Anders Neumann is a leading physician (ledende overlæge) in Region Midtjylland who serves as a member of the steering committee for [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease [^src1]. His role reflects the regional structure of DANIBD's governance, which encompasses representation from all five Danish regions [^src1].

DANIBD is a comprehensive patient registry that collects data on inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) — including Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, short bowel syndrome, and primary sclerosing cholangitis — from patients treated at public Danish hospitals [^src1]. The database achieves coverage exceeding 90 percent based on validation against regional disease registries [^src1]. Neumann's membership on the steering committee places him among clinicians and patient representatives responsible for the database's oversight and direction [^src1].
